description.en: The GT20 is a 3-in-1 robot vacuum and mop with LDS SLAM navigation, 5000Pa suction and 120–150 minutes of runtime. It sweeps and mops with a 220ml dustbin and 230ml water tank, supports App control (Tuya) and voice control (Alexa / Google Assistant), and offers smart mapping, no-go zones and virtual walls, obstacle avoidance and auto recharge. OEM/ODM customisation available for colour, voltage and plug type. Certification documents on file.
description.zh: GT20 是扫拖一体的三合一扫地机器人，采用 LDS SLAM 激光导航，吸力 5000Pa，续航 120–150 分钟。220ml 尘盒 + 230ml 水箱，支持 APP（涂鸦）与语音控制（Alexa / Google），具备智能建图、禁区与虚拟墙、越障避让、自动回充等功能。支持 OEM/ODM 定制颜色、电压与插头规格，认证资料已备案。

reviews.name: Thomas Mueller
reviews.title: LDS laser navigation works flawlessly — mapped our 3BR house in 8 minutes
reviews.body: We have a large open-plan living area with some rugs and furniture. The LDS mapping is surprisingly accurate and it navigates around chair legs without bumping. The app control is intuitive. Here are some screenshots of the cleaning route and the dust compartment after one week.

reviews.name: Linda Park
reviews.title: Quiet enough to run at night, strong enough for pet hair
reviews.body: We have two cats and this robot handles the fur better than expected. It runs at about 55dB which is quiet enough to have on while watching TV. The auto-recharge and resume feature is essential for our 150m² apartment.

reviews.name: Carlos Mendez
reviews.title: Good OEM base — we customized the logo and packaging for our brand
reviews.body: We are a home appliance distributor in Latin America. The OEM customization service was excellent — they printed our brand logo and designed custom retail packaging. The robot vacuum itself is reliable and our customers rate it 4.5/5 on average.
